description: This file defines the FileHistory entity class, representing the historical records of files associated with merchant stores in an e-commerce system. It includes properties like file ID, store, size, dates for creation, deletion, and accounting, as well as download counts.

classes.name: FileHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing the historical record of files in merchant store order management, mapped to the FILE_HISTORY database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this file history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this file history record.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Retrieves the merchant store associated with this file history.

methods.name: setStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this file history.

methods.name: getFileId
methods.description: Gets the ID of the file this history entry refers to.

methods.name: setFileId
methods.description: Sets the file ID for this history record.

methods.name: getFilesize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFilesize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getDateAdded
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the file was added.

methods.name: setDateAdded
methods.description: Sets the date when the file was added.

methods.name: getDateDeleted
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the file was deleted.

methods.name: setDateDeleted
methods.description: Sets the date when the file was deleted.

methods.name: getAccountedDate
methods.description: Gets the date associated with account processing.

methods.name: setAccountedDate
methods.description: Sets the date for account processing.

methods.name: getDownloadCount
methods.description: Returns how many times the file has been downloaded.

methods.name: setDownloadCount
methods.description: Sets the number of downloads for this file.
